Moreno Valley Warm Centers

Warm Centers Are Now Open

When temperatures drop or during rainy days, residents may seek refuge at the City of Moreno Valley's designated Warm Centers. Pursuant to CDC and the California Department of Public Health, masks will be required for all staff, volunteers, and visitors. Warm Centers are available to any resident having trouble dealing with cold temperatures. Warm Centers are ideal solutions for seniors and those with health conditions that may worsen in the frigid temperatures.

Precautions to take during cold or wet weather:

  • Check on seniors
  • Bring pets inside
  • Stay indoors during
  • Minimize travel
  • Keep a winter survival kit in your vehicle
  • Check tire pressure, heater, and defroster
  • Bring an umbrella
  • Wear layers of loose-fitting, lightweight, warm clothing, and a hat
  • Wear Rainboots or Waterproof shoes
  • Mittens, snug at the wrist, are better than gloves
  • Try to stay dry and away from the wind
